subject.title: Add persistent cron job execution history with filtering

question: Which cron history surface should OpenClaw core support beyond the current SQLite cron.runs path, and what redaction, access, export, follow, and retention rules must apply?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the remaining work changes public CLI, protocol, config, stored-state maintenance, and security-sensitive history behavior, so automation should not choose the durable audit-history contract alone.

options.title: Narrow cron.runs expansion
options.body: Add timestamp filters and a focused CLI/docs surface on the existing SQLite reader, then defer export, follow, aggregates, prune, and vacuum to separately scoped decisions.

options.title: Full audit-history suite
options.body: Implement logs/history CLI, export/follow, success-rate summaries, and retention/prune commands together after a larger security and UX design pass.

options.title: Retain current scope
options.body: Document existing cron.runs and cron.runLog.keepLines behavior as the supported surface and explicitly narrow or close the remaining feature request.

recommendation.title: Narrow cron.runs expansion
recommendation.body: Add timestamp filters and a focused CLI/docs surface on the existing SQLite reader, then defer export, follow, aggregates, prune, and vacuum to separately scoped decisions.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the strongest combined signal from cron run-history feature history, current blame, and prior issue review context.
